about: First-party scope index for the 15 skills under skills/. It is data, not frontmatter: a host routes by SKILL.md description, so editing 15 frontmatters would change every skillHash and mark measured cells stale for no consumer benefit. Every id appears exactly once. A skill that only makes sense in one repo type belongs to a scope, not to a stack-specific filter.

pipeline.about: Move an idea to a reviewed change: capture, process, groom, prompt, implement, and the optional blind-spot pass.

verify.about: Read-only checks that decide whether a change or a document set holds.

observe.about: Read-only situational awareness across branches, worktrees, PRs, backlog and CI.

maintain.about: Set up and keep the harness current: bootstrap, tighten one gate, catch a branch up with its base.

record.about: Write a decision down, including what was traded away.

data.about: Reserved: a measured data skill would go here. Empty because 0.9.0 measured the official datacontract skills and justified no local one (SPEC-0085); they remain companions pinned in companion-skills.json.
